title: Where she was when World War II broke out; Palladium with Teddy Hill
summary: She first thinks she saw trenches in Hyde Park and played the Palladium for six weeks with Teddy Hill's band, then recalls hearing of Pearl Harbor on a bus in New York.

World War II broke out. I was in Europe. I was in Europe because I know -- I saw them digging the trenches in Hyde Park, and I was working in one of the -- someplace in London -- in -- either in the provinces or someplace in England.
I'm trying to think -- was the Palladium after that?

Yes.
